This work is based on Simple Elevator with Animation by lhaegy.fu, licensed under CC BY 4.0.
The official downloaded E01 archive's embedded license.txt identifies this original source.
Downloaded through Elevator, uploaded by ART_LOLL:
https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/elevator-221312f2fd7f47af8ba0003f4573f1dd

Parallax adaptation (2026-11-14): glTF/BIN source converted to portable Unity meshes/materials/prefab;
coordinate normalization and nonuniform scale; source-preview wall and ground omitted; old arrow glyphs
replaced by runtime 1/B1 displays; rear-wall aperture clipped behind original mirror plane and original
mirror surface changed to translucent frosted glass; added physical collisions and inner display housing.
Source geometry, materials and four independently sliding door components are preserved where applicable.
No downloaded Godot scripts were included or executed. No sound assets are included in this adaptation.
